data.name: GitErrorTimedOut

data.name: GitErrorOutputLimit
data.value: Git produced more output than this reader permits. Inspection was stopped; unusually large commit messages may require another Git tool.

data.name: GitErrorNotWorktree

data.name: DivergenceAvailable
data.value: Ahead: {0}; behind: {1}. Upstream: {2}. Local snapshot: {3:g}. No remote contact; the server may have newer commits. Both counts compare this upstream, which can differ from a configured push destination. Pull and Push are not implemented.

data.name: DivergenceStale

data.comment: {0}/{1} counts, {2} full upstream ref, {3} local snapshot date/time.

data.name: DivergencePending
data.value: Comparison not available yet. Counts use locally recorded upstream history; Pull and Push are not implemented.

data.name: DivergenceNoUpstream

data.name: DivergenceMissingUpstream
data.value: The configured upstream ref is missing locally. No remote request was made. Pull and Push are not implemented.

data.name: DivergenceDetached
data.value: Detached HEAD has no branch upstream to compare. Pull and Push are not implemented.

data.name: DivergenceUnborn
data.value: This branch has no commits to compare. Pull and Push are not implemented.

data.name: DivergenceShallow
data.value: This shallow repository may lack ancestry needed for complete counts. No counts are claimed. Pull and Push are not implemented.

data.name: DivergenceFailed
data.value: Comparison failed or was cancelled. History remains available; refresh to retry. Git output, if available, is in Diagnostics. Pull and Push are not implemented.

data.name: ComparingDuration
data.comment: {0} is elapsed local-read time in seconds, including history reading.

data.name: RemoteBadgeHelp
data.value: Remote-tracking branch {0}; last locally fetched position, not a live server check.

data.name: ActionExplainNewBranch
data.value: Create a local branch from the selected commit or reference. No existing branch is replaced. Checking it out requires a clean worktree.

data.name: ActionExplainSwitchBranch
data.value: Switch to an existing local branch. Requires a clean worktree; changes are never discarded.

data.name: ActionExplainFetch
data.value: Download remote branches into their remote-tracking refs. Rewritten remote tips are reflected locally; local branches are unchanged. No pruning. Reachable tags may be downloaded.

data.name: ActionExplainPull
data.value: Fetch the selected remote branch and fast-forward the current local branch. Requires a clean worktree; divergence stops without a merge or rebase.

data.name: ActionExplainPush
data.value: Publish the selected local branch to the named branch on the selected remote. Existing remote commits are not overwritten by force.

data.name: ActionRemoteBranch
data.value: Branch on remote (name without remote prefix)

data.name: ActionAllRemotes
data.value: Fetch every listed remote (sequentially; stop on failure)

data.name: ActionAllTags
data.value: Push all local tags as well (some refs may succeed if others fail)

data.name: ActionSetUpstream
data.value: Set this destination as the local branch's upstream

data.name: ActionAuthLimits
data.value: Uses existing credential helpers and SSH agents. Git credential and bundled OpenSSH prompts open in Shovel. Verify host fingerprints independently before accepting; OpenSSH may save accepted hosts. Browser sign-in through Credential Manager, interactive hooks and signing prompts still require your terminal. Shovel does not save credentials; configured Git helpers may store them.

data.name: ActionReady
data.value: Review the targets and options, then start this operation.

data.name: ActionOutput
data.value: Git output (in memory; URL credentials redacted)

data.name: ActionCancelQuestion
data.value: Stop Git and its owned child processes? Changes may already have been applied locally or remotely. Cancellation does not undo them. Shovel will inspect the repository again.

data.name: ActionRunning
data.value: Git is running. Supported authentication requests open a prompt. Cancel if an unsupported hook or helper is waiting. Five-minute command timeout.

data.name: ActionCancelling
data.value: Stopping owned processes, then checking repository state…

data.name: ActionSucceeded
data.value: Operation completed. Review refreshed history before the next action.

data.name: ActionResultExited
data.value: Git reported failure. Some changes may already have applied; inspect the output and refreshed state. Resolve the cause, then reopen this dialog.

data.name: ActionResultCancelled
data.value: Stopped. Local or remote changes may already have applied. Review the refreshed state; cancellation is not rollback.

data.name: ActionResultTimedOut
data.value: Git timed out and was stopped. Check the output and repository state before retrying; changes may already have applied.

data.name: ActionResultOutputLimit
data.value: Git exceeded the output limit and was stopped. Check repository state before retrying; changes may already have applied.

data.name: ActionResultStartFailed
data.value: Git could not start. Check Git installation, permissions and available disk space.

data.name: ActionIdentityChanged
data.value: The repository identity changed or could not be verified. Close this dialog and reopen the repository.

data.name: ActionUnsupportedRemote
data.value: This remote configuration cannot be represented safely yet (multiple URLs, unusual name or too many remotes). Use your terminal for this configuration.

data.name: ActionOtherInstance
data.value: Another Shovel instance is changing this repository or a linked worktree. Wait for it to finish, then reopen this dialog.

data.name: ActionChanged
data.value: Repository refs, HEAD or configuration changed while this dialog was open. Nothing was started. Reopen the dialog to review current targets.

data.name: ActionChangedAfterFetch
data.value: Fetch completed, but repository state changed before fast-forwarding. The local branch was not advanced by Shovel. Review history and reopen the dialog.

data.name: ActionSequence
data.value: A merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert or other sequence is already in progress. Resolve or abort it with your terminal before starting this operation.

data.name: ActionWorktreeUnsupported
data.value: Checkout and Pull are not supported yet for repositories with submodules or sparse checkouts. Use your existing Git tools.

data.name: ActionDirty
data.value: The worktree or index has changes, including untracked files. Commit, stash or move them with your existing tools before retrying. Shovel did not discard them.

data.name: ActionNoStart
data.value: No commit is available at the selected starting reference. Create the first commit with your existing tools, or choose another reference.

data.name: ActionNoRemote
data.value: No configured remote is available. Add one with your existing Git tools, then reopen this dialog.

data.name: ActionAttachedRequired
data.value: Pull requires an existing, checked-out local branch.

data.name: ActionBranchName
data.value: Enter a valid branch name without a leading dash, control characters or @ expressions. Existing branches are never replaced.

data.name: ActionOutputLimit
data.value: Combined output exceeded the one-megabyte limit. Earlier commands may have completed. Review repository state before retrying.

data.name: ActionCustomSsh
data.value: Custom core.sshCommand configurations require an interactive transport design that is not available yet. Use your terminal; configuration was not changed.

data.name: ActionSshMissing
data.value: The selected Git installation has no recognized bundled OpenSSH executable. Use your terminal or select a standard Git for Windows installation.

data.name: ActionReadFailed
data.value: Operation preparation or validation failed. Check repository availability, Git ownership, permissions and locks, then reopen the dialog. Shovel never deletes lock files automatically.

data.name: ActionCustomMergeOptions
data.value: This branch has custom merge options that may change fast-forward behavior. Use your terminal for this Pull; Shovel has not changed the configuration or started fetching.

data.name: ActionAskPassMissing
data.value: The authentication helper is missing. Keep all preview files together, then reopen this dialog. No network operation was started.

data.name: ActionWaitingAuthentication
data.value: Waiting for authentication input. Cancelling the prompt stops this operation; changes already applied are not undone.

data.name: AuthPromptSource
data.value: Request from Git or a configured program (untrusted text):

data.name: AuthSafety
data.value: Only reply if this request matches the operation you started. For a new SSH host, verify the displayed fingerprint independently before typing yes. Replies are hidden, including usernames and host-key replies. Shovel keeps no credential copy after sending it; configured Git helpers may store credentials. This prompt expires after two minutes. Cancelling stops the operation without undoing changes.

data.name: ActionAuthenticationUnavailable
data.value: The authentication prompt connection failed or returned an invalid response. Git was stopped. Review refreshed repository state and reopen the operation to retry.

data.name: ActionAuthenticationTimedOut
data.value: The authentication prompt expired after two minutes. Git was stopped. Changes already applied are not undone; review refreshed state before retrying.

data.name: ActionAuthenticationPromptLimit
data.value: The operation exceeded the limit of 16 authentication requests and was stopped. Review the authentication configuration and refreshed repository state before retrying.

data.name: ActionAlreadyAttempted
data.value: Close and reopen this dialog to review current targets before another attempt.
